item.arcana.arcane_crystal.lore: A shard of arcane magic, torn from the deep places.
item.arcana.ascension_core.lore: The heart of a fallen archmage. Lifts a wand beyond itself.
item.arcana.awakening_shard.lore: Stirs a dormant wand to wakefulness.
item.arcana.chronos_crystal.lore: A shard of chronos magic, torn from the deep places.
item.arcana.core_spirit.lore: Spells return a little life to you.
item.arcana.crimson_crystal.lore: A shard of crimson magic, torn from the deep places.
item.arcana.forbidden_fragment.lore: A piece of a wand that should not exist.
item.arcana.glacier_crystal.lore: A shard of glacier magic, torn from the deep places.
item.arcana.rune_amplify.lore: More power at a higher mana cost.
item.arcana.rune_leech.lore: Heal for a share of the damage you deal.
item.arcana.solar_crystal.lore: A shard of solar magic, torn from the deep places.
item.arcana.storm_crystal.lore: A shard of storm magic, torn from the deep places.
item.arcana.verdant_crystal.lore: A shard of verdant magic, torn from the deep places.
item.arcana.void_crystal.lore: A shard of void magic, torn from the deep places.
screen.arcana.cost_hint: Changing a part consumes the new item and returns the old one.
spell.arcana.arcane_barrage.desc: A volley of homing arcane missiles.
spell.arcana.arcane_bolt.desc: A piercing bolt with an unpredictable wild effect. Hold to charge.
spell.arcana.arcane_cataclysm.desc: Ultimate: telegraphed pillars of arcane energy crash down.
spell.arcana.blizzard.desc: Ultimate: a raging blizzard that grinds enemies down and flings them around its eye.
spell.arcana.blood_seal.desc: Draw an explosive glyph that slows everything inside, then detonates.
spell.arcana.chain_lightning.desc: Lightning leaps between enemies with fading damage.
spell.arcana.chrono_surge.desc: Hasten yourself and allies while slowing enemies.
spell.arcana.crimson_cataclysm.desc: Ultimate: five crimson shockwaves; every hit heals you.
spell.arcana.crimson_chains.desc: Bind an enemy and drag them toward you. Awakened wands bind several.
spell.arcana.crimson_wave.desc: A crescent of crimson energy sweeps outward.
spell.arcana.dawnlight.desc: Heal and cleanse allies; burn the undead.
spell.arcana.echo.desc: Repeat the last spell you cast, from any wand.
spell.arcana.event_horizon.desc: Ultimate: a black hole with an accretion disc that devours the battlefield.
spell.arcana.frost_nova.desc: A ring of frost that slows enemies and freezes shallow water.
spell.arcana.frozen_prison.desc: Encase an enemy in ice; the prison shatters for heavy damage.
spell.arcana.gravity_crush.desc: Lift enemies into the air, then slam them into the ground.
spell.arcana.grove_guardians.desc: Ultimate: summon guardians of the grove and root every enemy nearby.
spell.arcana.ice_spikes.desc: Spikes erupt in a line, freezing what they pierce. Hold to charge; awakened wands send a fan.
spell.arcana.mimic_arcane.desc: Copy the primary spell of Arcane magic. Only works on schools you cast recently.
spell.arcana.mimic_chronos.desc: Copy the primary spell of Chronos magic. Only works on schools you cast recently.
spell.arcana.mimic_crimson.desc: Copy the primary spell of Crimson magic. Only works on schools you cast recently.
spell.arcana.mimic_glacier.desc: Copy the primary spell of Glacier magic. Only works on schools you cast recently.
spell.arcana.mimic_solar.desc: Copy the primary spell of Solar magic. Only works on schools you cast recently.
spell.arcana.mimic_storm.desc: Copy the primary spell of Storm magic. Only works on schools you cast recently.
spell.arcana.mimic_verdant.desc: Copy the primary spell of Verdant magic. Only works on schools you cast recently.
spell.arcana.mimic_void.desc: Copy the primary spell of Void magic. Only works on schools you cast recently.
spell.arcana.mini_sun.desc: A small sun scorches enemies, then bursts in a blinding explosion.
spell.arcana.rewind.desc: Return to where you stood, and how healthy you were, five seconds ago.
spell.arcana.rift_collapse.desc: Ultimate: a collapsing rift unleashes every school before imploding.
spell.arcana.rift_step.desc: Tear a rift and blink forward. Awakened wands damage everything along the trail.
spell.arcana.root_snare.desc: Roots erupt along the ground, wounding and rooting enemies. Hold to charge; awakened wands send a fan.
spell.arcana.singularity.desc: Hurl a dark orb that becomes a gravity well, dragging in everything nearby. Hold to charge.
spell.arcana.solar_beam.desc: A piercing beam of light. Hold to charge; ascended wands sustain and sweep it.
spell.arcana.spore_bloom.desc: A spore cloud that heals allies, poisons enemies and makes crops grow.
spell.arcana.static_field.desc: Overcharge yourself: move faster and zap nearby enemies.
spell.arcana.supernova.desc: Ultimate: a sun gathers overhead and detonates across a huge radius.
spell.arcana.tempest.desc: Ultimate: a thunderstorm that rains bolts over a wide area.
spell.arcana.temporal_slow.desc: A time-dilation field slows enemies and projectiles. Hold to charge.
spell.arcana.terrain_warp.desc: Warp the ground for a few seconds and toss enemies aloft. Blocks always return.
spell.arcana.thorn_barrier.desc: A thorned ring that heals allies and repels enemies.
spell.arcana.thunderbolt.desc: Call down lightning. Hold to charge; awakened wands call a volley.
spell.arcana.time_stop.desc: Ultimate: enemies and projectiles in range freeze in time.
spell.arcana.unstable_rift.desc: Open a rift that randomly pulls, shoves, scatters and lashes enemies.
tooltip.arcana.forbidden: Bound to no school. Borrows every magic.
tooltip.arcana.menu_hint: Press G to evolve and customise
